review: Reviewed the retained round-365 pause of Lin: ordinary-484 failed with 'fetch failed' 117 ms after it started (2026-11-26T19:25:09Z), with no response and no retained failure evidence, so it carries no error code or retry-after. The opt-in transport recovery requires retained transport evidence (fix-log 9a), so repair issued this technical handoff instead of resuming. The failed call keeps its reservation and is never resent; Lin decides again with a separate charge. This recovery installs no package, assigns no interface, reviews no request and changes no source, budget or experimental policy. It only closes the pause, so empty handoffs leave it uncounted.
